Android Checkout Library
org.solovyev.android:checkout:1.2.1

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.

The bundled checkout-1.2.1.aar is a locally patched build of the
Apache-2.0-licensed Android Checkout Library. The patch adds the
required Android receiver export flag for compatibility with modern
Android versions.

Original project:
https://github.com/serso/android-checkout
